claims.text: The proposed model outperforms previous extractive and abstractive models on ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and METEOR scores.
The performance improvement of the model is more pronounced with longer documents, indicating its effectiveness in summarizing such texts.
The model achieves state-of-the-art results on the Pubmed and arXiv datasets, outperforming traditional methods by a narrow margin.
